kinematics.boundaryCondition: Prescribe exact affine UX/UY at every exterior displacement node; all interior displacement DOFs remain free.
kinematics.quadraticBoundaryNodeRule: T6/Q8 boundary midside values are evaluated from the actual physical coordinate after every transformation.

quantityAuthority.probeDisplacement: The frozen P1-P4 affine displacement oracle is retained, but current LOCAL_CONTINUUM_RESULT exposes nodal displacements rather than a governed arbitrary-point displacement recovery. Base acceptance therefore compares every mesh-node displacement to the exact affine field and records P1-P4 as NOT_DIRECTLY_RECOVERABLE until a governed direct physical-point method exists.
quantityAuthority.planeStrainSigmaZZ: compare to independent oracle if exposed by result contract; otherwise receipt must state OUTSIDE_CURRENT_RESULT_CONTRACT, never zero by implication

reactionConvention.oracleBoundaryTraction: t = sigma . n using outward boundary normal
reactionConvention.localChecks: retain exact edge traction and edge force/moment resultants; current result contract does not expose element-decomposed reaction contributions, so local edge-reaction parity is retained as unavailable rather than inferred from corner reaction partitioning

T3.policy: constant-strain T3 area integration as implemented by registered route

meshValidity.T3Orientation: registered canonicalizer may deterministically normalize triangle orientation
meshValidity.T6Q8Orientation: corner node declaration must be counter-clockwise; reject rather than silently reorder
meshValidity.jacobian: T6/Q8 detJ must be positive at every production quadrature point; any non-positive quadrature-point detJ is fail-closed
meshValidity.quadraticMidside: B01 mesh definitions require each T6/Q8 midside node to be the exact physical midpoint of its parent edge; a violating negative case must not be silently repaired
meshValidity.topology: duplicate identities, unresolved references, disconnected restrained islands, and governed interface violations are fail-closed according to negative-case definitions

TRANSLATED.relation: strain/stress/energy invariant; displacement reevaluated on transformed physical field

ROTATED_37_DEG.relation: vectors and second-order tensors transform covariantly; energy invariant; engineering shear handled via tensor transform

UNIT_SCALED_MM_TO_M.relation: compare canonical physical values after unit conversion

netMoment.freezeNote: This scale-aware moment criterion was declared before first execution of the new B01 registered-route harness.

normalizedFreeDofInfinityResidual.freezeNote: The normalization denominator was declared before first execution of the new B01 registered-route harness.

acceptance.nearZeroRule: use absolute criterion; do not divide by a nearly zero reference

solverGovernance.mechanismBehavior: under-restrained rigid-body mechanism must fail; no accepted result
solverGovernance.regularization: any stiffness regularization/pivot modification that can mask a mechanism must be explicit in retained solver configuration; silent stabilization is forbidden
